subject: CAIQ attestation roadmap and evidence coordination — Helios Bank
messages:
From: Audits Team <audits@heliosbank.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ request — initial scope and timeline

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks again for agreeing to take the Helios Bank CAIQ review. We have a tight window for our vendor diligence: procurement needs the completed CAIQ and supporting artifacts by Dec 10. To get started, can you confirm the following by EOD Monday (Nov 22)?

- Point person for control-level evidence (who will own the answers and uploads)
- Preferred format for artifact intake (Drive folder v. upload portal)
- Any controls we should exclude/up-front scope limitations (tenant isolation, on-prem variants, etc.)

I attached our CAIQ template and a short intake checklist. If convenient, wed like a 30-minute walkthrough next week to align on evidence locations and any redactions.

Maya Ortiz
CISO, Helios Bank
Audits Team

Attachments: helios-caiq-template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), initial-intake-checklist.pdf (pdf stub)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Audits Team <audits@heliosbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CAIQ request — initial scope and timeline

Maya — thanks, received.

Quick answers inline:
- Point person: I will own the mapping and the internal orchestration. For artifact uploads, Ill delegate owners per control and track delivery.
- Format: Drive folder is ideal; we can also push a curated zip if you prefer a single bundle at the end.
- Scope: We plan to scope to Redwood hosted and Dedicated (no on-prem package) — I will flag any controls that only apply to private/on-prem installs when we hit them.

Im copying Marissa to confirm artifact owners and Priya for runtime/telemetry artifacts. I can run the 30-minute walkthrough the morning of Nov 24 or Nov 30 — what works for your team?

Next steps (our side):
1) Ill produce a control-by-control assignment and initial evidence stub (spreadsheet) by Nov 22.
2) Owners will have two weeks to stage artifacts in the shared Drive.
3) Well do a 30-min walkthrough to walk through any redactions or log extracts.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Security Programs | Redwood Inference
redwood.ai
Mobile: (415) 555-0119

Attachments referenced: redwood-caiq-crosswalk-v0.9.xlsx (draft)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CAIQ request — owner assignments and evidence sprint

Karthik — assigning provisional owners here based on current responsibilities:

- Network diagram & segmentation: Priya Natarajan
- Key management / HSM / KMS controls: Marissa Cole (security infra)
- Runtime telemetry & request logs: Priya Natarajan + Runtime team (I'll loop in Diego if needed)
- Change management / release proofs: Me (release ops)

Ill pull the latest network-architecture-diagram.pdf from the runbook and drop it in the Drive. Priya, can you gather the telemetry retention policy and a 7-day sample of request logs (sanitized) by Nov 29? Helios asked for an early sample for their instrumentation team.

If we need redactable exports, call out the fields and Ill coordinate with SRE.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Security Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments added: network-architecture-diagram.pdf (diagram stub)

From: Audits Team <audits@heliosbank.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CAIQ request — initial scope and timeline

Thanks — that plan works. We prefer Drive for iterative work and a single zipped bundle for the formal submission. Nov 29 sample date is fine.

One ask before the walkthrough: can Redwood provide an annotated crosswalk mapping Helioss CAIQ questions to your internal control names and the exact artifact filenames (example: CCM-AL.1 -> network-architecture-diagram.pdf)? That will make review much faster. If you can put the annotated crosswalk in the shared Drive by Nov 24, we can pre-read and keep the walkthrough focused.

Also, please include a short note on any compensating/alternate controls where full evidence is constrained.

Maya Ortiz
CISO, Helios Bank

Requested live walkthrough windows: Nov 24 09:00-11:00 or Nov 30 10:00-12:00 (PST).

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Audits Team <audits@heliosbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CAIQ request — annotated crosswalk and walkthrough confirmed

Maya — confirmed.

We uploaded redwood-caiq-crosswalk-v0.9.xlsx to the Drive (link above) and added an "artifact filename" column with the locations for each control. We also added a short "notes" column where owners flagged compensating controls or data-redaction requirements.

We can do the walkthrough on Nov 30 at 10:30 PST — Ill set a calendar invite and include a 15-minute buffer to share the Drive link and pre-read instructions. Priya will bring a sanitized 7-day log sample; Marissa will present the network diagram and KMS attestation note.

If Helios wants a formal zip earlier, say Nov 27, say the word and well accelerate packaging. Otherwise well stick to the December 10 final target.

Thanks — looking forward to the session.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Security Programs | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
